_note: Error-correcting code models. Logical error per round: p_L = prefactor * (p_eff/threshold)^exponent(d). 'phys_per_logical' counts data + syndrome qubits of one logical patch. layout_overhead multiplies the patch count for routing space (lattice surgery). These are generic textbook-level fits, not a replacement for a circuit-level simulation.

surface.label: Rotated surface code
surface.source: Fowler et al., PRA 86, 032324 (2012): p_L ~ 0.1 (p/p_th)^((d+1)/2), p_th ~ 1 %. 2d^2-1 qubits per rotated patch. CCZ factory footprint/time: order-of-magnitude from Gidney & Fowler (2019).

bivariate_bicycle.label: Bivariate-bicycle qLDPC ('gross' family)
bivariate_bicycle.source: Bravyi et al., Nature 627, 778 (2024): [[144,12,12]] gross code, 288 physical qubits for 12 logical. Threshold and prefactor are rough fits; needs long-range connectivity.
